title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Cour 2 Reveals Trailer, Theme Songs, Key Visual, October 11 Premiere
content: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 anime revealed a trailer for its Cour 2, which is set to release in October 2026. Studio SILVER LINK returned to animate, with twelve episodes released in the first part. The anime previously revealed a teaser .
author: Anime Corner

title: Noragami's Adachitoka Launches New Manga
content: The October issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine announced on Friday manga duo Adachitoka will launch a new manga titled Yadoya no Oinu-sama (The Inn's Dog) in the next issue on October 6. Adachitoka posted a preview image of the manga on their X/Twitter account on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, Second Promo
content: • The official website for Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3 ) television anime revealed additional cast, new staff, a second key visual (pictured), and the second promotional video Friday.

title: 'Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo, Theme Songs
content: The official website of the Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ( I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ) television anime revealed two additional cast, the theme songs, a second key visual (pictured), and a second promotional video on Friday.

title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in a Different World as an Aristocrat Season 2's Video Reveals More Cast, January Debut

title: Live-Action Look Back Film's Clip Highlights Kyōmoto, Fujino Creating Manga
content: The official website for the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga presented a new clip from the film on Friday. The clip shows Kyōmoto and Fujino creating a manga together.
